Name: Cononiah, Chief of the Levites
Summary: Cononiah, chief of the Levites with Shemaiah, Nethaneel, Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, gave the Levites five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover.
KeyStory: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Shemaiah, Chief of the Levites; Nethaneel, Chief of the Levites; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Levite chiefs gave so their brethren could serve without lack.
